title: The Secret Sanyu Told
subtitle: Sanyu's Growing Heart
author: Anthony Mwesigwa
description: Sanyu learns the hard way that not every secret is hers to share.
keywords: gossip, speech, tongue, discretion, Uganda, girls, virtue, words
dedication: For every girl learning to guard what she hears and speaks.
authorBio: Anthony Mwesigwa is a passionate storyteller from Kampala, Uganda, dedicated to creating engaging books for young African readers.
backCoverText: Sanyu overhears something interesting—and tells everyone! But when her words hurt someone, she learns why some things should stay unsaid.
